crossRefs.note: So I bought a belt according to Yahweh’s word, and put it on my waist.

people.name: Euphrates
people.line: Major river in ancient Near East; boundary of Promised Land

translations.web: After many days, Yahweh said to me, “Arise, go to the Euphrates, and take the belt from there, which I commanded you to hide there.”
translations.bsb: Many days later the LORD said to me, “Arise, go to Perath, and get the loincloth that I commanded you to hide there.”
translations.kjv: And it came to pass after many days, that the LORD said unto me, Arise, go to Euphrates, and take the girdle from thence, which I commanded thee to hide
translations.asv: And it came to pass after many days, that Jehovah said unto me, Arise, go to the Euphrates, and take the girdle from thence, which I commanded thee to hide there.
